run_gen_retrieval_multicore: run gen_retrieval_multicore to generate EGO4D retrieval results from video annotations and proposal CSVs
run_Soft_NMS: run Soft_NMS on a DataFrame to filter overlapping temporal proposals using Gaussian score decay
run_IOU: run IOU to compute the intersection over union of two temporal segments given start and end times
run_rm_other_category: run rm_other_category to filter a DataFrame keeping only rows whose labels match ground truth annotations
run__gen_retrieval_video: run _gen_retrieval_video to generate a ranked list of temporal proposals for a single video
